gaps.sentence: He is very ___ to criticism and takes it personally.
gaps.hint: easily affected or hurt; pattern: ___ to
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to something' means easily affected or upset by it; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.

gaps.sentence: The committee ___ of eight members and two advisers.
gaps.explanation: 'Consist of' = be made up of; 'composes of' is wrong.

gaps.sentence: The medicine had an immediate ___ on her breathing.
gaps.explanation: 'An effect on' — the noun form is required here.

gaps.sentence: We ___ money by cycling to work instead of driving.
gaps.hint: to keep money instead of spending it
gaps.explanation: 'Save money by doing something' means to avoid spending it; 'earn' means to receive money for work.
'Complement' means to combine well with or complete something; 'compliment' means to praise.

gaps.sentence: Teenagers ___ hours every day on social media.
gaps.hint: to use time or money on something (neutral)
gaps.explanation: 'Spend time/money on something' is the neutral verb for using time or money; 'waste' implies useless use.

gaps.sentence: ___ of the film, the hero rides off into the sunset.
gaps.hint: the final part of something (film, book, street)
gaps.explanation: 'At the end of something' refers to the final part; 'in the end' means finally, after a process.

gaps.sentence: May I ___ your stapler for a second? Mine has jammed.
gaps.explanation: 'Borrow' = take for a while; 'lend' = give for a while.
